setlist.title: Beat It On Down The Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Truckin'** (1 review): The jam coming out of Truckin' into The Other One is called outstanding [10]

## Setlist highlights

- **Tomorrow Is Forever**: rare: 10 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd72-10-27.sbd-aud.cotsman.10286.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 177 min; rated 3.2/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer considers this version inferior and recommends the other complete audio of the concert for better overall sound; Reviewer calls this an excellent-sounding audience recording for its era that rewards playing loudly [8][11]
- **gd72-10-27.sbd-aud.cousinit.19630.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 172 min; rated 2.36/5 by 11 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds this much better sounding than the other two circulating 10/27/72 copies, after sampling only a few songs; The Bear-recorded audience portion of set two sounds spectacular, while the first soundboard portion is clean but flat and bass-light; The second soundboard portion is many generations removed and loses much clarity [4][5][9][12]
- **gd72-10-27.set1-sbd.hanno.18849.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 13 songs; 80 min; rated 1.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Set 1 soundboard copy sounds muddy and lacks both high and low end, with no clarity [7]

## Around the show

- The info file includes a warning about this recording [1]
- Reviewer says The Other One into Half Step happened at no other show, and rates the show below average otherwise [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd72-10-27.sbd-aud.cotsman.10286.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard and Audience composite [1]. Also: Set 1 comes from a soundboard source; set 2 is an audience recording, passed through several unspecified generations to CD; Copy came via Paul Hartman and Chris Masciangelo, and J. Cotsman seeded it to etree [1]
- **gd72-10-27.sbd-aud.cousinit.19630.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Set two circulates fully as a Bear audience tape, but soundboard fills in much of its second half here [5]
- **gd72-10-27.set1-sbd.hanno.18849.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Reviewer suspects a multi-generation tape, since it sounds like the other Oct 27 copies but without clarity [7]
